clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, night elf acolytes are called to the Temple of the Moon after proving their devotion to their people. There, the Sisterhood of Elune teaches them sacred arts of their faith.

Night elf priests draw their holy power from Elune, their goddess, while humans and dwarves turn to the Light. When an acolyte serves the realm with steadfast devotion, the Sisterhood in Darnassus takes notice. The acolyte is summoned to the Temple of the Moon and judged ready for deeper communion. There, the priest learns sacred spells passed down through thousands of years of worship.

Priestess Alathea calls the initiate to receive instruction in holy mysteries of the night elf faith, including Starshards. These spells channel the radiant wrath and grace of the White Lady. The teaching marks an acolyte's passage beyond basic training, ready to venture beyond Teldrassil's protective canopy in Elune's name.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've proven yourself worthy of Elune's attention. If you feel you're ready, I would very much like to teach you one of her spells unique to our people.
